action_prompt: 检测城镇排水管道内的结构性和功能性缺陷
full_prompt: Task definition: Detect all pipe defects in the input image. MAXIMIZE RECALL: it is far better to output a false positive than to miss a real defect. Scan the entire image thoroughly, including edges, corners, dark areas, and areas near the pipe wall. Output ONE object for EVERY defect you see, including those that are small, faint, blurry, partially visible, at the image border, or adjacent to other defects. When you are uncertain whether something is a defect, OUTPUT IT anyway - do not skip it. Never output an empty array unless you are absolutely certain there is nothing unusual in the image. There is no limit on the number of objects. Defect categories: AJ: Unauthorized branch tie-in. BX: Cross-section deformation. CJ: Sediment on invert. CK: Stepped offset joint. CR: Wall crack. FS: Wall corrosion. JG: Hard scale buildup. PL: Wall fracture. SG: Root intrusion. TJ: Disconnected joint. TL: Joint material loss. ZW: Foreign object obstruction. Output format: bbox_2d must be four JSON strings ["<loc_qx1>","<loc_qy1>","<loc_qx2>","<loc_qy2>"] where each q is an integer bin from 0 to 999, quantized as round(normalized_coordinate*999/1000). Output a valid JSON array wrapped by <obj> and </obj>. Sort objects by y1 ascending. If absolutely no defect is visible, output <obj>[]</obj>. Output only <obj>...</obj> with no explanation, prefix, suffix, or Markdown. Example: <obj>[{"bbox_2d":["<loc_120>","<loc_450>","<loc_380>","<loc_619>"],"label":"CR"},{"bbox_2d":["<loc_500>","<loc_500>","<loc_699>","<loc_799>"],"label":"SG"}]</obj>.

code_to_desc.AJ: 支管暗接：支管未通过检查井直接侧向接入主管
code_to_desc.BX: 变形：管道受外力挤压造成形状变异
code_to_desc.CJ: 沉积：杂质在管道底部沉淀淤积
code_to_desc.CK: 错口：同一接口的两个管口产生横向偏离，未处于同一轴线上
code_to_desc.CR: 管壁裂纹：管道内壁或外壁出现线状、网状或贯穿性的裂缝
code_to_desc.FS: 腐蚀：管道表面受腐蚀介质侵蚀发生损坏
code_to_desc.JG: 结垢：含铁或石灰质的水长时间沉积于管道表面形成硬质或软质结垢
code_to_desc.PL: 破裂：管道的外部压力超过自身的承受力致使管材发生破裂
code_to_desc.SG: 树根：单根树根或树根群自然生长进入管道
code_to_desc.TJ: 脱节：两根管道的端部在接口处脱离连接
code_to_desc.TL: 接口材料脱落：管道接口处的填缝、密封或连接材料发生脱落
code_to_desc.ZW: 障碍物：管道内影响过流的阻挡物

standard_reference: CJJ 181-2012，2012-07-19发布，2012-12-01实施，中华人民共和国住房和城乡建设部发布
note: full_prompt、英文类别表和中文类别定义保持同一代码语义；3000 数据集的训练、推理与评估均使用 full_prompt。
